schedule: Three batch64 screens on ext4: each with one warmup and three scored rounds per arm, in rotated order. 30 seconds initial cooldown per cell and 5 seconds between invocations. No score-selected reruns. Point workloads are not measured in this screen.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput per exact binary and workload; p99 and grouping counters come from the same invocation. Flagged measurements and historical v4 data remain identified separately.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run independently using mean timings; a passing mean does not exclude brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Do not modify grouping, FRONTIER, sync, or wire code.
Do not infer full performance qualification from a batch-only screen.
All scratch databases are inside the local repository and only run-owned databases are removed.
The SSD showed stalls in previous captures; preserve and flag all samples.
